about: Previous-release tests allowed to fail against the new source, because behaviour changed on purpose (workspace letter H6, rule 3; scripts/release/previous-tests.ts). Each entry: the test file and name, the version the change ships in, and why. A test failing that is not listed fails the release gate. Only the release just before is run, so an entry is dropped at the next release (2.1.0's four, for tail calls portable, are in git history at ec6dc1bba; 2.2.0's one, D2's type rule, dropped at 2.2.2; 2.2.2's two, DG7's words, dropped at 3.0.3; 3.0.3's six, the release order D1, dropped at 3.0.4). A name is written as previous-tests.ts reports it: Node's JUnit reporter escapes a double quote twice and the script decodes once, so a quote reads ".

entries.name: is a CI job that installs the browsers and requires all of them
entries.reason: Owner, 2026-11-11 (fail fast + Playwright's container): ci.yml's browser check is two jobs, each running `bun run browsers --require-all --only=…` (Playwright's engines in its image; Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera on the runner). The 3.0.3 test required the single line `bun run browsers --require-all`; the 3.0.4 test requires the two `--only` lines, and ci_browsers.test.ts that together they are every browser. CI only; nothing in either package.
